posts.description: Ever feel stuck and don't know which way to go? HERBACK helps. Tell it your decision, and it builds a real roadmap — clear next steps, useful resources, and stories from people who've faced the same thing. No generic advice, just an actual plan. Despite the name, HERBACK is for everyone — every "her," "him," "they" who's ever felt stuck. Built this because we've been there too many times. Try it out, and let me know what you're working through!

posts.name: Nextool AI Academy
posts.tagline: Learn AI like Duolingo.
posts.description: Nextool Academy is a bite sized learning platform for practical AI skills. Instead of long courses and hours of theory, you learn through short lessons, quizzes, real world examples, prompts, and hands on tasks. Learn how to use AI for work, business, marketing, productivity, content, and everyday tasks. Lessons stay short, practical, and easy to follow, even if you are starting from zero. Think Duolingo, built for AI skills.

posts.name: The Nook
posts.tagline: A little corner for the things that make you, you.
posts.description: Step into a place where wonder lives — a cozy sanctuary of sound, ideas, and stories, all waiting for the girl who needs a moment to breathe, dream, and remember who she is. It asks one question: “What kind of girl are we today?” And then it listens, without judgment, without hurry. Because sometimes, the most important thing you can do is simply be.

posts.name: AURA — Rhythm & Pattern Intelligence
posts.tagline: Understand your patterns. Own your rhythm.
posts.description: AURA goes beyond period tracking by helping women understand recurring patterns in mood, appetite, libido, energy, and body sensations. It turns simple check-ins into personal insights, then connects those insights to practical Body & Mind guidance, safety resources, and empowerment tools. Instead of just tracking what happened, AURA helps users understand what it might mean and what to do next.

posts.name: TaskFlow
posts.tagline: Turn project requirements into organized team tasks
posts.description: TaskFlow helps university teams turn project requirements into organized, actionable tasks. Upload a project document to generate tasks with estimated hours, then manually assign them to team members. It keeps teams in control while promoting clearer workload visibility, coordination, and accountability. Supports PDF, TXT, JPG/JPEG, PNG with a Maximum size: 5MB

posts.name: Tafsiri Radiolojia
posts.tagline: Understand Your Radiology Report in English and Swahili
posts.description: Introducing 'Tafsiri Radiolojia'. A Radiology report interpretation app. Tafsiri Radiolojia turns paper radiology reports into plain Kiswahili/English via camera OCR, with voice readout, so East African patients understand results without EHR access or English fluency. Nothing is stored or indexed, given how sensitive imaging reports are. Built for paper-first, low-connectivity realities.

posts.name: Portabase
posts.tagline: Open-source platform to back up and restore your data.
posts.description: Portabase is an open-source, self-hosted platform designed to simplify the backup and restoration of databases and Docker volumes. It supports 9 database engines (including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, and SQL Server). From one intuitive dashboard, manage distributed agents, automated schedules, flexible retention policies, remote storage, notifications, restores, and migrations. Portabase gives teams a reliable, transparent, and sovereign way to protect their critical data.

posts.name: Nexvion Copilot
posts.tagline: The AI screen guide that never needs a tutorial.
posts.description: Nexvion Copilot is a zero-shot visual AI guide built as a lightweight Chrome extension. Instead of switching tabs to read outdated documentation or scrub through videos. Our smart Ghost Cursor visually highlights exactly where to click next across any web dashboard in real time—with strict single-tab privacy.

posts.name: Loadout
posts.tagline: Where gamers trade with confidence
posts.description: Game asset trading is a a hassle today with hundreds of niche Discord and Reddit communities overflowing with scammers or unsatisfied users. Loadout aims to solve the problem by providing gamers with a fair marketplace. Sellers can reach a large audience for every product without having to contact and convince buyers on a case-to-case basis. Buyers get exactly what they want. Payments managed by an escrow to prevent fraud by either side. Valorant listings live, more coming soon!

posts.name: HabitPivot
posts.tagline: The daily habit copilot that adapts when life gets busy
posts.description: Most habit trackers treat routines as static, all-or-nothing checklists that cause guilt when life gets busy. HabitPivot is an adaptive AI health companion that flexes with your real day. What makes it stand out: 1. 1-Tap "Friction Pivot": Instantly scales 15-min tasks down to 30-sec micro-resets on low-energy days to protect your streak. 2. Adaptive 3-Block System: Morning, Midday, and Evening routines calibrated to your schedule. 3. Safeaty-First Coaching: Educates without diagnosing.

posts.name: Raksha Bandhan Songs
posts.tagline: Classic Raksha Bandhan (Rakhi) songs free.
posts.description: Play classic Raksha Bandhan (Rakhi) songs free — a music player celebrating the timeless bond of brothers and sisters. Stream the full festival playlist online.

posts.name: AsyncFlow — Zero Meetings. Forever.
posts.tagline: AI workspace that kills all meetings. Forever.
posts.description: AsyncFlow eliminates all meetings for remote teams — forever. Submit async voice or text updates, get Gemini AI summaries automatically, and replace video interviews with a 5-round async hiring system. Every decision is timestamped in a legal audit trail. No standups. No syncs. No video interviews. Built for teams that work on their own terms.

posts.name: Keyline Icons
posts.tagline: 585 icons on one 24 grid, built for shadcn/ui
posts.description: 585 drawings on a single 24x24 grid, in stroke, duotone and fill: 1,497 SVGs in all. Built to one standard rather than collected: 2px keylines, the same corner radii, the same gap between parts, every drawing. Duotone and fill are derived from the stroke drawing, so the three weights can never disagree. Copy one from the site, npm i @keyline-icons/react, add one at a time with the CLI, or drop one onto a Figma canvas with the plugin. MIT, no attribution.

posts.name: Clipster
posts.tagline: Organize your clipboard across Mac, Windows & iPhone
posts.description: Clipster is not just clipboard history — organize everything you copy into Pins, find it in a keystroke, and sync it end-to-end encrypted across Mac, Windows & iPhone. Free to start

posts.name: GiftableSong
posts.tagline: Personalized songs made from real memories
posts.description: GiftableSong turns names, relationships, and real memories into a personalized song gift. Create two song versions, preview each for 60 seconds, then pay once to unlock the version you choose. Share it through a private gift page with full streaming, lyrics, cover art, and a personal note.

posts.name: NoroHunt
posts.tagline: Discover tools worth your time with NoroHunt
posts.description: NoroHunt is a curated software tools directory. Browse products, compare alternatives, find deals, and create a free account to submit and manage tool listings.

posts.name: Fresnel
posts.tagline: AI camera relighting for macOS
posts.description: Fresnel analyzes your camera feed in realtime with Apple's Neural Engine to insert virtual lights into the scene. With a click, change if you are in a well-lit studio, a candle-lit corner or a colorful YouTube setup. Using on-device AI depth estimation, Fresnel understands the 3D shape of everything in front of your camera. Then it lets you place virtual studio lights into that space and renders the result live into a virtual camera you can use in Zoom, OBS, etc.

posts.name: Indexly
posts.tagline: Get organic traffic for your B2B SaaS
posts.description: Indexly is an AI SEO agent that finds the keywords your competitors rank for, scores every opportunity, and writes and auto-publishes SEO-optimized articles to your blog so you get discovered on Google, ChatGPT, and Perplexity on autopilot.

posts.name: Dialogue Book Podcasts
posts.tagline: Turns Books into Personalized Podcasts
posts.description: Book summaries as podcast conversations. Learn self-help, parenting, startups, and wellbeing from the world's best non-fiction. Grow with every episode.

posts.name: Brand someone's Mac
posts.tagline: Permanent etching of your logo on someones new mac.
posts.description: Sponsors bid on 12 laser-etched spots on a MacBook lid. When the goal is reached we buy the Mac, etch the winning logos into the aluminium forever, and ship it. Every sponsor gets a permanent dofollow backlink as well and is visible forever on the leaderboard page.

posts.name: Just Story It V2
posts.tagline: Original audio stories, written and voiced for you tonight
posts.description: Pick a narrator. Pick a genre. Pick how long you've got. Just Story It writes an original story for you and reads it aloud — every character voiced by its own performer, so a mystery sounds like a mystery and a comedy lands its lines. Six narrators with real range. Ten genres to mix. Your own characters and places, carried from story to story. Save what you love to playlists, pick up where you left off, and listen from the lock screen. Start with four free minutes.

posts.name: Brand My GPU
posts.tagline: Your logo on my RTX 5090. 10 spots, live auction
posts.description: I'm financing an RTX 5090 by auctioning the one surface every builder photographs: the shroud. Ten die-cut vinyl positions, each dimensioned in real millimetres against the card's actual geometry. Spin the 3D card, pick a spot, bid. Outbid = instant refund.

posts.name: Fudge Explorer
posts.tagline: Design inspiration prompts for ChatGPT, Claude and Agents
posts.description: Fudge Explorer is a visual way to browse real website captures and bring the right reference into your AI workflow. Explore pages by purpose, typography, color, domain, or visual similarity, then open any capture as a ready-made prompt for ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Each prompt includes the screenshot, original page, and its design guide, so your AI can work from a concrete reference instead of a vague description.

posts.name: Habits Monitor
posts.tagline: Your daily habit companion with streaks & insights
posts.description: Most habit trackers cap free habits at 10, charge for sync, or lock stats behind a paywall. Habits Monitor does none of that. Unlimited habits, flexible scheduling (daily, weekdays, N×/week), streaks that never cap, a calendar heatmap, and 14-day planning — all offline-first with optional encrypted cloud sync. ~6 MB. No account required. Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose & Material 3.

posts.name: Seminara
posts.tagline: Live presentations. Unlimited scale. Zero camera time.
posts.description: Seminara is an autonomous presentation platform that deploys a digital teammate to run your live sessions. Whether you are presenting a report, training teams, or nurturing prospects, our AI host presents your slides and answers attendee questions out loud in real time. Achieve unlimited scale and give every attendee a guided, interactive experience with zero camera time.

posts.name: FollowUp Desk
posts.tagline: A private follow-up desk for WhatsApp warm leads
posts.description: Track warm leads, next follow-up dates, stages, notes and editable message starters in a local browser tool. No login, cloud, AI, automated WhatsApp messaging or subscription. You review every message before it opens in WhatsApp. ₹499 once.

posts.name: Chesspoly
posts.tagline: Chess with an economy: earn coins, build your army
posts.description: Chesspoly is a strategy game where every match starts with a lone king and 3 coins. Move non-king pieces to earn coins, spend them to build your army, and find checkmate. Play online, against the computer, or together.
